subject: Request: Out-of-band sign-on + equity refresh for Evelyn Wu (Sr. Inference)
messages:
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.ai>
Date: 2028-03-22T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Senior Inference hire — need OOB sign-on + equity refresh

Hi Soojin,

Quick ask: Evelyn Wu (referral, ex-AI infra at Concord) just wrapped onsite and the loop loved her — strong infra + LLM latency experience. Comp band for Sr. Inference Engineer tops out at $210k base, 0.25% equity. Candidate has a competing offer at $240k base + 0.4% and wants an immediate decision.

Hiring manager (Marcus) is asking for a $25k out-of-band base uplift and a one-time $40k sign-on, plus an equity refresh to 0.35% (front-loaded 25% cliff). We are at headcount for Q1; Marcus proposes reassigning an open L4 role from Platform to Inference to keep headcount neutral.

I attached Evelyn's resume and the hiring packet. Can you start the approval track? Need a decision by EOD Friday — candidate timeline is tight.

Attachments: Evelyn_Wu_resume.pdf (PDF)

Thanks,
Rishi
Sr. Hiring Manager, Inference
Redwood Inference

From: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.ai>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai>
Date: 2028-03-22T09:46:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Senior Inference hire — need OOB sign-on + equity refresh

Thanks Rishi — looping in Comp & People.

Laura / Stephanie — summary below and attached resume. Request: $25k base uplift (OOB), $40k sign-on (one-time), equity refresh to 0.35%. Marcus proposes headcount reorg (move an L4 Platform req into this slot) to avoid incremental headcount. Candidate timeline: needs written offer by 3/24 EOD.

Can you confirm whether comp band approval + equity refresh is OK and whether People will sign off on headcount carve? If Comp approves, I will route for final leadership sign-off (Marcus / Laura) and push an offer to Evelyn.

Thanks — Soojin
Recruiting, Redwood Inference

From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: 2028-03-22T11:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Senior Inference hire — need OOB sign-on + equity refresh

On Wed, Mar 22, 2028 at 9:46 AM Soojin Lee wrote:
> Thanks Rishi — looping in Comp & People.

Reviewed quickly: Evelyn is a high-priority hire for the latency work. Comp guidance: we can approve a one-time, limited out-of-band uplift for critical senior hires but prefer trade-offs (sign-on vs base). Proposed counter that fits approvals without setting a broad precedent: $15k base uplift (one-year limited band exception), $35k sign-on (one-time), equity bump to 0.32% with a 12-month performance refresh clause. This keeps recurring comp exposure lower but allows us to win the hire.

I will prepare a formal comp memo for Marcus and Laura to sign. Please confirm Marcus can accept the slightly lower numbers vs his ask. Once Marcus signs, I will attach the approval PDF for records.

- Stephanie
Head of Compensation, Redwood Inference

From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai>
Date: 2028-03-23T10:18:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Senior Inference hire — need OOB sign-on + equity refresh

Thanks team — read the memo. I agree to Stephanie's counter: $15k base uplift + $35k sign-on + 0.32% equity with the 12-month refresh clause.

On headcount: Confirmed I will reassign the open L4 Platform req into this slot; Marissa, can you mark REQ-834 as moved from Platform to Inference and update headcount tracker? We cannot exceed our headcount plan for Q1 without exec approval, so this needs to be a lateral reassign.

Please prepare the offer doc with the numbers Stephanie approved. Once Marissa confirms the req move, Laura — can you do final People sign-off so we can send the offer to Evelyn today (ideally)?

- Marcus
VP, Inference

From: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.ai>
To: Evelyn Wu <evelyn.wu@gmail.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>
Date: 2028-03-24T16:03:00-07:00
Subject: Official offer — Senior Inference Engineer (Redwood Inference)

Hello Evelyn,

Great speaking earlier — excited to extend an offer to join Redwood Inference as a Senior Inference Engineer. Below are the high-level terms (formal offer attached):

- Base salary: $225,000 (includes one-year limited uplift)
- One-time sign-on: $35,000 (paid first payroll)
- Equity: 0.32% (with standard vesting; 12-month performance refresh clause documented in offer)
- Start date: flexible, ideally by 2028-05-01

Attachments: offer_evelyn_wu_2028-03-24.pdf (formal offer), comp_approval_marcus_2028-03-23.pdf (signed approval)

Next steps: Please review and return the signed DocuSign by 3/28 if you're comfortable. Happy to jump on a quick call if you'd like to talk through the package.

Best,
Soojin Lee
Senior Technical Recruiter, Redwood Inference
Phone: (415) 555-0191
